# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7/v6.9 yuan-korea (oe_yk_, phases 1-3 + M5). Generated by gen_yuan_korea.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope, monthly: called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES id 40 "yk") while
# OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_init } }. This line writes no monthly hook of its own.
# Order: start, close, the readings (stance, king, break, phase, exile), then from 81 (1344.1) the Goryeo side (a request
# drafted or asked), phase 3 W4/W5, the lapses, the event for a human Goryeo, the event for the Yuan.
oe_yk_monthly = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_init } } oe_yk_setup = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_m value = oe_yk_m_now }
        oe_yk_end_check = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on }
            oe_yk_watch = yes
            if = {
                limit = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_t_early AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_m global_var:oe_yk_m >= 81 } } }
                oe_yk_kings = yes
                oe_yk_req_step = yes
                oe_yk_dh_step = yes
                oe_yk_ev_lapse = yes
                oe_yk_kor_pick = yes
                oe_yk_ev_pick = yes
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_y1n value = global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 } }
    }
}
# Any scope. The first run in a game (design 4.1): before 1356.6.1, with a Mongol Yuan and with Goryeo the line opens (a 1337 game; the
# scheduler runs only there); otherwise it stays off (oe_yk_end 8 too late, 4 no Mongol Yuan, 5 no Goryeo).
oe_yk_setup = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yk_init
    if = {
        limit = { current_date < 1356.6.1 oe_yk_yuan_ok = yes country_exists = c:KOR }
        set_global_variable = oe_yk_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_phase value = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_stance value = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_brides value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_n1 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_n4 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_n9 value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ask value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_kr_skip value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_syg_backed value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ki value = 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_m value = oe_yk_m_now }
        oe_yk_stance_step = yes
        debug_log = "oe_yk: the line opens (Goryeo's stance [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_stance')|0]; events from 1344.1)"
    }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1356.6.1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_end value = 8 } debug_log = "oe_yk: too late, the line stays off (code 8)" }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yk_yuan_ok = no } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_end value = 4 } debug_log = "oe_yk: no Mongol Yuan, the line stays off (code 4)" }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_end value = 5 } debug_log = "oe_yk: no Goryeo, the line stays off (code 5)" }
}
# Any scope (F6's COLLAPSE_HOOKS, a hook; also this line's own monthly check). The Yuan has fallen: the line ends with code 4.
oe_yk_on_yuan_fall = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on } oe_yk_finish = { code = 4 } }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The end: the collapse or no longer a Mongol Yuan (4), Goryeo gone (5), 1400.1.1 (6), or 10 peaceful
# non-subject years in the epilogue (3).
oe_yk_end_check = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { oe_yk_fallen = yes oe_yk_yuan_ok = no } } oe_yk_on_yuan_fall = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:KOR } } oe_yk_finish = { code = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { current_date >= 1400.1.1 } oe_yk_finish = { code = 6 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            global_var:oe_yk_phase ?= 4
            oe_yk_kor_sub = no
            oe_yk_kor_war = no
            has_global_variable = oe_yk_free_m
            has_global_variable = oe_yk_m
            global_var:oe_yk_m >= oe_yk_free_end
        }
        oe_yk_finish = { code = 3 }
    }
}
# Any scope. Usage: oe_yk_finish = { code = N }: this line's modifiers off, the line closed (oe_yk_end = N).
oe_yk_finish = {
    oe_yk_strip = yes
    remove_global_variable = oe_yk_on
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_end value = $code$ }
    debug_log = "oe_yk: the line ends (code in oe_yk_end)"
}
# Any scope. Removes this line's modifiers on Goryeo (oe_yk_strip_ki only the Gi clan's; oe_yk_strip all). Opinions run out by themselves.
oe_yk_strip_ki = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yk_ki_height } remove_country_modifier = oe_yk_ki_height } } }
}
oe_yk_strip = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yk_ki_height } remove_country_modifier = oe_yk_ki_height } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_yk_new_king } remove_country_modifier = oe_yk_new_king } } }
}
# Any scope (interface, design 4.4). Usage: oe_yk_add_influence = { amount = N }: vanilla's Mongol influence count of Goryeo, only
# while vanilla has set it (flavor_kor.1, from 1340; through Y1's oe_y1_kor_influence).
oe_yk_add_influence = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { oe_y1_kor_influence = { amount = $amount$ } } }
}
# Any scope. Debug counter: events sent by this line (global oe_dbg_n_yk).
oe_yk_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_yk } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yk value = 0 } }
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_yk add = 1 }
}
# Any scope. Goryeo's stance (design 3.2, the first rule that holds): 0 hostile (at war with the Yuan, or failed Deokheung
# deposition without restoration for 10 years); 1 drifting away (not a subject, or broken away with the count at 0 or gone and
# no raised son-in-law rule); 3 compliant (a subject with the Zhengdong marker, the count at 3 or more, or the raised son-in-law
# rule); 2 kept in hand (the rest).
oe_yk_stance_step = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:KOR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_stance value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { oe_yk_kor_war = yes oe_yk_dh_hostile = yes } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_stance value = 0 } }
    else_if = { limit = { OR = { oe_yk_kor_sub = no AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_break oe_yk_inf_low = yes } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_stance value = 1 } }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_yk_loyal_now = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_stance value = 3 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_stance value = 2 } }
}
# Any scope, monthly. The stance; the break of 1356 recorded once (design 2.3: 1 Y1 .6 a, 2 vanilla's flavor_kor.4, 3 no longer a
# subject; the Gi clan's modifier goes with it); Red Turban sack of Goryeo's capital; exiled pretender's quiet death; epilogue
# independent-peace timer; phase transitions 1 -> 2 -> 3.
oe_yk_watch = {
    oe_yk_stance_step = yes
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_st_6 ?= 1 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_y1st6_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_y1st6_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_break } country_exists = c:KOR }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y1_zd_end ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_break value = 1 } }
        else_if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y1_zd_end ?= 1 c:KOR = { dynamic_historical_event_fired = flavor_kor.4 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_break value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_y1_zd_end ?= 3 oe_yk_kor_sub = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_break value = 3 } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_break }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_break_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
            oe_yk_strip_ki = yes
            debug_log = "oe_yk: Goryeo broke with the Yuan (reason [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_brk')|0])"
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_kor_sacked } oe_yk_kor_cap_rtr = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_kor_sacked value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_yk: Red Turbans occupied Goryeo's capital"
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_exile_m
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_exile_done }
            has_global_variable = oe_yk_m
            global_var:oe_yk_m >= global_var:oe_yk_dh_exile_m
        }
        oe_yk_dh_exile_dies = yes
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yk_phase ?= 4 oe_yk_kor_sub = no oe_yk_kor_war = no }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_free_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_free_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_free_m }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yk_free_m
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_phase ?= 1 OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_break AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_m global_var:oe_yk_m >= 230 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_phase value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yk: enters phase 2" }
    if = {
        limit = {
            global_var:oe_yk_phase ?= 2
            has_global_variable = oe_yk_break
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_st_8 }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_st_6 global_var:oe_yk_break ?= 3 }
            has_global_variable = oe_yk_m
            global_var:oe_yk_m >= oe_yk_dh10_lo
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_phase value = 3 } debug_log = "oe_yk: enters phase 3"
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly from 1344.1. Kings: when the line wakes, the king of the moment is marked as seen (without Y1 also as invested:
# nobody can tell otherwise); a king not seen before is a change of king (oe_yk_king_m; a human's skipped tries are forgotten).
oe_yk_kings = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_kseen0 } }
        set_global_variable = oe_yk_kseen0
        # (Y1 marks the king of 1337 and the one its .3 invested)
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yk_seen } } } }
        c:KOR = { ruler = { set_variable = oe_yk_seen } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_king_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_kr_next } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_kr_next } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_kr_skip value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_yk: Goryeo has a new king"
    }
}
# Any scope, monthly from 1344.1. The Goryeo side (design 3.3, 3.6 W1): with no request pending, a request for a new king (rolled in
# its window) or the periodic one; an AI Goryeo's is drafted at once by W1, a human Goryeo is asked in .2. A pending .2, .5, .7 or
# .11 whose Goryeo has become an AI is answered by W1 / W2 / W3 / W4 instead.
oe_yk_req_step = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d2 oe_yk_kor_human = no } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d2 } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_d2 } oe_yk_w1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d5 oe_yk_kor_human = no } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d5 } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_d5 } oe_yk_w2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d7 oe_yk_kor_human = no } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d7 } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_d7 } oe_yk_w3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 oe_yk_kor_human = no } if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 } oe_yk_w4 = yes }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d1 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d2 } oe_yk_out_free = yes oe_yk_may_ask = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ask value = 0 }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yk_kr_open = yes }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_kr_next global_var:oe_yk_m >= global_var:oe_yk_kr_next } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ask value = 1 } }
            else = { random = { chance = oe_yk_kr_ch set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ask value = 1 } } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_yk_per_open = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_req_m } global_var:oe_yk_m <= 116 NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_t_early } }
                random = { chance = oe_yk_per_ch set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ask value = 2 } }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ask value = 2 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yk_ask > 0 }
            c:KOR = { ruler = { set_variable = oe_yk_kr_done } }
            if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_ask ?= 1 has_global_variable = oe_yk_kr_next } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_kr_next }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
            if = { limit = { oe_yk_kor_human = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d2 value = 1 } }
            else = { oe_yk_w1 = yes }
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. W1 (design 3.6; M5 decision 304): drafts the request of an AI Goryeo (oe_yk_req: 5 Shen's claim when a new king
# succeeds during 1339-1355 and SYG is a Yuan subject, else 1 investiture while uninvested; else by weight: 2 a bride 40
# (80 without any consort), 3 the girls 30 (50 at stance 2), 4 gifts 60), then makes .1 due. Nothing fits (a drifting
# Goryeo with nothing to ask): no request this time.
oe_yk_w1 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yk_king_bare = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_yk_ok_shen = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 5 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { if = { limit = { has_ruler = yes } ruler = { set_variable = oe_yk_shen_done } } } } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yk_ok_wed = yes oe_yk_ok_girls = yes oe_yk_ok_gift = yes } }
        random_list = {
            40 = { trigger = { oe_yk_ok_wed = yes c:KOR = { has_consort = yes } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 2 } }
            80 = { trigger = { oe_yk_ok_wed = yes c:KOR = { has_consort = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 2 } }
            30 = { trigger = { oe_yk_ok_girls = yes global_var:oe_yk_stance ?= 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 3 } }
            50 = { trigger = { oe_yk_ok_girls = yes global_var:oe_yk_stance ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 3 } }
            60 = { trigger = { oe_yk_ok_gift = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = 4 } }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_req ?= 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_wed_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_req >= 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d1 value = 1 } debug_log = "oe_yk: W1, Goryeo asks the Yuan (request [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_req')|0])" }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yk: W1, Goryeo has nothing to ask this time" }
}
# Any scope. W2 (design 3.3): an AI Goryeo answers the levy, at the chance fixed when .4 was sent (oe_yk_p4).
oe_yk_w2 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_roll value = 0 }
    random = { chance = oe_yk_p4_sv set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_roll value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_roll = 1 } oe_yk_levy_two = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_w2 value = 1 } }
    else = { oe_yk_levy_refuse = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_w2 value = 3 } }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yk_roll
}
# Any scope. W3 (design 3.4): an AI Goryeo answers .6 a (70% apology, else refusal). No debug_log (called from .20).
oe_yk_w3_apology = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { add_stability = stability_weak_penalty } } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus } } oe_yk_add_influence = { amount = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ki value = 2 }
}
oe_yk_w3_refuse = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_plus } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_ki value = 1 }
}
oe_yk_w3 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_roll value = 0 }
    random = { chance = 70 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_roll value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_roll = 1 } oe_yk_w3_apology = yes }
    else = { oe_yk_w3_refuse = yes }
    remove_global_variable = oe_yk_roll
}
# Any scope. W4 core (design 3.5; no debug_log so .11 a worker can call it): raises Prince Deokheung's pretender rebel in the
# Uiju province (nobles + half the peasants), progress 0.25 (AI) / 0.15 (human), +0.05 if M5 backed & loyal SYG.
oe_yk_w4_core = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR }
        if = {
            limit = { c:KOR = { NOT = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } } }
            c:KOR = {
                if = {
                    limit = { character:oe_yk_deokheung ?= { is_alive = yes } }
                    character:oe_yk_deokheung = { move_country = c:KOR save_scope_as = oe_yk_dh }
                }
                else = {
                    create_character = {
                        dynasty = dynasty:wang_dynasty
                        culture = culture:korean_culture
                        religion = c:KOR.religion
                        first_name = oe_yk_name_hye
                        age = 45
                        mil = 35
                        script = oe_yk_deokheung
                        save_scope_as = oe_yk_dh
                    }
                }
                scope:oe_yk_dh = { set_variable = oe_yk_deokheung }
                create_rebel = {
                    category = pretender
                    name = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels
                    rebel_demand = oe_yk_demand_deokheung
                    save_scope_as = oe_yk_rebel
                }
                scope:oe_yk_rebel = { set_variable = { name = var_oe_yk_pretender value = scope:oe_yk_dh } }
                scope:oe_yk_dh = { change_character_allegiance = scope:oe_yk_rebel }
                province_definition:uiju_province = {
                    every_location_in_province_definition = {
                        limit = { owner ?= c:KOR }
                        every_pop = {
                            limit = { pop_type = pop_type:nobles }
                            add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_penalty
                            change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_yk_rebel
                        }
                        every_pop = {
                            limit = { pop_type = pop_type:peasants }
                            random = {
                                chance = 50
                                add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_penalty
                                change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_yk_rebel
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_yk_kor_human = yes }
                    scope:oe_yk_rebel = { add_rebel_progress = 0.15 }
                }
                else = {
                    scope:oe_yk_rebel = { add_rebel_progress = 0.25 }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_yk_syg_loyal = yes global_var:oe_yk_syg_backed ?= 1 }
                    scope:oe_yk_rebel = { add_rebel_progress = 0.05 }
                }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_go_m } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_go_m }
    }
}
oe_yk_w4 = {
    oe_yk_w4_core = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yk: W4, Prince Deokheung crosses the Yalu into Uiju"
}
# Any scope. Finds Prince Deokheung (saved as scope:oe_yk_dh_c) and exiles him to CHI; dies silently 12 months later (as Y1).
oe_yk_find_dh = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_dh_c } clear_saved_scope = oe_yk_dh_c }
    if = {
        limit = { character:oe_yk_deokheung ?= { is_alive = yes } }
        character:oe_yk_deokheung = { save_scope_as = oe_yk_dh_c }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung is_alive = yes } } }
        c:KOR = { random_character = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_yk_dh_c } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung is_alive = yes } } }
        c:CHI = { random_character = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_yk_dh_c } }
    }
}
oe_yk_dh_exile = {
    oe_yk_find_dh = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_dh_c }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } scope:oe_yk_dh_c = { move_country = c:CHI } }
        scope:oe_yk_dh_c = { set_variable = oe_yk_exiled_pretender }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_exile_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_exile_m add = 12 }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_exile_done } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_exile_done }
    }
}
oe_yk_dh_exile_dies = {
    set_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_exile_done
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_ex_t } clear_saved_scope = oe_yk_ex_t }
    if = {
        limit = { character:oe_yk_deokheung ?= { is_alive = yes has_variable = oe_yk_exiled_pretender } }
        character:oe_yk_deokheung = { save_scope_as = oe_yk_ex_t }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_yk_exiled_pretender is_alive = yes } } }
        c:CHI = { random_character = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yk_exiled_pretender is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_yk_ex_t } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_character = { has_variable = oe_yk_exiled_pretender is_alive = yes } } }
        c:KOR = { random_character = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yk_exiled_pretender is_alive = yes } save_scope_as = oe_yk_ex_t } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_ex_t }
        kill_character_silently = scope:oe_yk_ex_t
        debug_log = "oe_yk: the exiled Prince Deokheung died quietly"
    }
}
# Any scope. W5 (design 3.5): settles the Deokheung campaign (early if already won/lost, else at 6 months hard timeout cap),
# always cleans up the rebel and queues .12 for CHI.
oe_yk_w5 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_p12 value = oe_yk_w5_calc }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 5 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_end_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d12 value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_yk: W5, Prince Deokheung already rules Goryeo"
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                oe_yk_dh_alive = no
                AND = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { NOT = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } } }
                AND = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { NOT = { any_rebel = { any_character_supporting_rebel = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } } } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } }
            c:KOR = { random_rebel = { limit = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } save_scope_as = oe_yk_rebel_x } }
            destroy_rebel = scope:oe_yk_rebel_x
        }
        oe_yk_dh_exile = yes
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_end_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d12 value = 1 }
        debug_log = "oe_yk: W5, Prince Deokheung's campaign already failed"
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_roll value = 0 }
        random = { chance = oe_yk_w5_calc set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_roll value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_yk_roll = 1 oe_yk_dh_alive = yes country_exists = c:KOR }
            oe_yk_find_dh = yes
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_dh_c }
                c:KOR = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_yk_dh_c }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { c:KOR = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } }
                c:KOR = { random_rebel = { limit = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } save_scope_as = oe_yk_rebel_x } }
                destroy_rebel = scope:oe_yk_rebel_x
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 5 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_end_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d12 value = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_yk: W5, Prince Deokheung took the throne of Goryeo (chance [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_p12')|0]%)"
        }
        else = {
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } }
                c:KOR = { random_rebel = { limit = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } save_scope_as = oe_yk_rebel_x } }
                destroy_rebel = scope:oe_yk_rebel_x
            }
            oe_yk_dh_exile = yes
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 4 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh_end_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d12 value = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_yk: W5, Prince Deokheung was defeated at Dalcheon (chance [GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_p12')|0]%)"
        }
        remove_global_variable = oe_yk_roll
    }
    oe_yk_stance_step = yes
}
# Any scope, monthly. Phase 3 step: launches W4 (AI KOR) or queues .11 (human KOR) one month after .10 a; runs W5 early if
# decided or at 6 months hard timeout cap.
oe_yk_dh_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yk_dh ?= 2 has_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_go_m has_global_variable = oe_yk_m global_var:oe_yk_m >= global_var:oe_yk_dh_go_m }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_yk_kor_human = yes }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 } NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_st_11 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d11 value = 1 } }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 } remove_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 }
            oe_yk_w4 = yes
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yk_dh ?= 3 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    AND = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } }
                    oe_yk_dh_alive = no
                    AND = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { NOT = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } } }
                    AND = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { NOT = { any_rebel = { any_character_supporting_rebel = { has_variable = oe_yk_deokheung } } } } }
                    AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_dh_m has_global_variable = oe_yk_m global_var:oe_yk_m >= oe_yk_dh_due }
                }
            }
            oe_yk_w5 = yes
        }
    }
}
# Any scope. Saves scope:oe_yk_at: the Yuan's location for the riders, the aim (the suppression's Gaoyou target while that campaign is fought, else Dadu) when the Yuan owns and controls it, else
# the Yuan's controlled location nearest to it (as Y7's oe_y7_find_spot); and scope:oe_yk_origin, Goryeo's capital.
oe_yk_find_spot = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_aim } clear_saved_scope = oe_yk_aim }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_at } clear_saved_scope = oe_yk_at }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_origin } clear_saved_scope = oe_yk_origin }
    if = { limit = { global_var:oe_y7_camp ?= 2 } global_var:oe_y7_tgt ?= { save_scope_as = oe_yk_aim } } if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_yk_aim } } location:dadu = { save_scope_as = oe_yk_aim } }
    if = { limit = { scope:oe_yk_aim = { owner ?= c:CHI controller ?= c:CHI } } scope:oe_yk_aim = { save_scope_as = oe_yk_at } }
    else = {
        c:CHI = { ordered_owned_location = { limit = { controller ?= c:CHI } order_by = { value = "distance_to(scope:oe_yk_aim)" multiply = -1 } max = 1 save_scope_as = oe_yk_at } }
    }
    c:KOR = { capital ?= { save_scope_as = oe_yk_origin } }
}
# Location scope (scope:oe_yk_at). One regiment of light cavalry of the age for the Yuan, raised from Goryeo (Y7 .11's form).
oe_yk_u_lc = { if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = levee_en_masse_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_6_revolutions_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI origin = scope:oe_yk_origin } } else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = military_revolution_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_5_absolutism_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI origin = scope:oe_yk_origin } } else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = artillery_institution_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_4_reformation_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI origin = scope:oe_yk_origin } } else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = pike_and_shot_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_3_discovery_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI origin = scope:oe_yk_origin } } else_if = { limit = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance } country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_advance = professional_armies_advance } } create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_2_renaissance_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI origin = scope:oe_yk_origin } } else = { create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = a_age_1_traditions_light_cavalry owner = c:CHI origin = scope:oe_yk_origin } } }
# Any scope. The levy granted: two regiments (W2 yes, .5 a) / one (.5 b), Goryeo's manpower, its opinion, the count and the
# suppression's momentum (two only).
oe_yk_levy_two = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:KOR }
        oe_yk_find_spot = yes
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_at exists = scope:oe_yk_origin } scope:oe_yk_at = { oe_yk_u_lc = yes oe_yk_u_lc = yes } }
        c:KOR = { add_manpower = -2 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yk_op_levy target = c:CHI } } } }
        oe_yk_add_influence = { amount = 1 }
        if = { limit = { oe_y7_running = yes } oe_y7_add_bonus = { amount = 2 } }
    }
}
oe_yk_levy_one = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CHI country_exists = c:KOR }
        oe_yk_find_spot = yes
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_yk_at exists = scope:oe_yk_origin } scope:oe_yk_at = { oe_yk_u_lc = yes } }
        c:KOR = { add_manpower = -1 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yk_op_levy_small target = c:CHI } } } }
    }
}
# Any scope. The levy refused: the count, Goryeo's liberty desire, the Yuan's opinion of Goryeo.
oe_yk_levy_refuse = {
    oe_yk_add_influence = { amount = -1 }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { add_liberty_desire = liberty_desire_weak_plus } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_yk_op_levy_refused target = c:KOR } } } }
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- events: senders and the pick (the sea-transport pattern)

    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yuan_ev_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_wait value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_last value = 1 }
    oe_yk_count = yes
    debug_log = "oe_yk: event oe_yk.1 sent to CHI"
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CHI } c:CHI = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_yk.1 } }
}

# Any scope. Drops what can no longer come: .3, .6, .8, .10 after their windows or superseded.
oe_yk_ev_lapse = {
    if = { limit = { oe_yk_lapse_3 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_st_3 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yk: event oe_yk.3 dropped (window over)" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yk_lapse_6 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_st_6 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yk: event oe_yk.6 dropped (window over or .8 fired)" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yk_lapse_8 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_st_8 value = 2 } debug_log = "oe_yk: event oe_yk.8 dropped (break recorded)" }
    if = { limit = { oe_yk_lapse_10 = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_st_10 value = 2 } if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_phase ?= 3 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_phase value = 4 } } debug_log = "oe_yk: event oe_yk.10 dropped (window over or skipped)" }
}
# Any scope. At most one event a month to a human Goryeo (.11 -> .7 -> .5 -> .2); it does not count in the Yuan's guard.
oe_yk_kor_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_yk_kor_human = yes NOT = { global_var:oe_yk_kor_m ?= global_var:oe_yk_m } }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d11 oe_yk_can_11 = yes } oe_yk_fire_11 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d7 oe_yk_can_7 = yes } oe_yk_fire_7 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d5 oe_yk_can_5 = yes } oe_yk_fire_5 = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_d2 oe_yk_can_2 = yes } oe_yk_fire_2 = yes }
    }
}
# Any scope. At most one event a month to the Yuan: due .12 / .1 first, else one roll for .6, .10, .8, .3, .9, .4. Nothing in a
# month in which another Yuan line already sent the Yuan an event, but due .12 / .1 wait at most 2 such months.
oe_yk_ev_pick = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_wait } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_wait value = 0 } }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yk_busy = no global_var:oe_yk_wait >= 2 } oe_yk_due_12 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_pick value = 12 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { OR = { oe_yk_busy = no global_var:oe_yk_wait >= 2 } oe_yk_due_1 = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_pick value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_yk_pick = 0 oe_yk_busy = no }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_pick = 0 oe_yk_open_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yk_ch_6 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_yk_pick = 0 oe_yk_open_10 = yes } random = { chance = oe_yk_ch_10 set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_pick value = 10 } } }

oe_yk_job_72 = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_paid value = oe_yk_take } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR country_exists = c:CHI } c:KOR = { add_gold = { value = global_var:oe_yk_paid multiply = -1 } add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_penalty } c:CHI = { add_gold = global_var:oe_yk_paid } } oe_yk_add_influence = { amount = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_dh value = 6 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_d12 value = 1 } }

# ---- TEST ONLY (DEV_LINES; the current player's country scope)

# Usage: oe_yk_test_req = { n = N }: request N as if Goryeo had asked (the stored sum computed), then .1 to the current player (the
# Yuan).
oe_yk_test_req = {
    if = {
        limit = { tag = CHI is_ai = no }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_m } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_m value = oe_yk_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req value = $n$ }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_yk_req_m value = global_var:oe_yk_m }
        oe_yk_fire_1 = yes
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yk TEST: the current player is not the Yuan (switch with tag CHI first); event oe_yk.1 not sent" }
}
# The line from now on: everything cleared, the start (the date, a Mongol Yuan and Goryeo still apply), and the 1344 start and the
# first periodic window skipped (test games only).
oe_yk_test_start = {
    oe_yk_test_clear = yes
    oe_yk_setup = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on } set_global_variable = oe_yk_t_early }
    oe_yk_log = yes
}
# One month of the line now (the scheduler's call; the month index moves to today).
oe_yk_test_month = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on } oe_yk_monthly = yes oe_yk_log = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_yk TEST: the line is not running (press ykstart first)" }
}
# Usage: oe_yk_test_inf = { n = N }: vanilla's Mongol influence count of Goryeo set to N (test games only), then the stance.
oe_yk_test_inf = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = kor_is_influenced_by_mongols value = $n$ } } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on } oe_yk_stance_step = yes }
    oe_yk_log = yes
}
# The King of Goryeo dies silently (as Y1's oe_y1.21): the next month of the line sees a new king.
oe_yk_test_king = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_ruler = yes } }
        c:KOR = { ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_yk_t_king } }
        kill_character_silently = scope:oe_yk_t_king
        debug_log = "oe_yk TEST: the King of Goryeo died"
    }
}
# Vanilla's marks this line reads, switched (set when missing, removed when set; test games only): the raised son-in-law rule
# (flavor_kor.5: kor_upgraded_son_in_law, the stance 3 and the count 5) and the recall of the Mongol generals
# (red_turban_rebellions.43: rtr_kor_will_break_away, W2 -20).
oe_yk_test_son = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_variable = kor_upgraded_son_in_law } } c:KOR = { remove_variable = kor_upgraded_son_in_law } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { set_variable = kor_upgraded_son_in_law } }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_yk_on } oe_yk_stance_step = yes }
    oe_yk_log = yes
}
oe_yk_test_rtr = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { has_variable = rtr_kor_will_break_away } } c:KOR = { remove_variable = rtr_kor_will_break_away } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KOR } c:KOR = { set_variable = { name = rtr_kor_will_break_away value = yes days = 7300 } } }
    oe_yk_log = yes
}

}

# W2 now, whoever plays Goryeo (the chance computed first): the riders or the refusal.
oe_yk_test_w2 = {

# Probe (design 5.2-1, the hard prerequisite of phase 3): in Goryeo, AI or not, a runtime person (Wang Hye, Prince Deokheung; script
# key oe_yk_deokheung) and a pretender rebel with this line's demand oe_yk_demand_deokheung; the person joins it, the nobles of the
# Uiju province (five places) with it; progress 0.15. Then the readings. Test games only. Once only while the rebel stands.
oe_yk_test_probe = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { NOT = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } } }
        c:KOR = {
            create_character = {
                dynasty = dynasty:wang_dynasty
                culture = culture:korean_culture
                religion = c:KOR.religion
                first_name = oe_yk_name_hye
                age = 45
                mil = 35
                script = oe_yk_deokheung
                save_scope_as = oe_yk_dh
            }
            scope:oe_yk_dh = { set_variable = oe_yk_deokheung }
            create_rebel = {
                category = pretender
                name = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels
                rebel_demand = oe_yk_demand_deokheung
                save_scope_as = oe_yk_rebel
            }
            scope:oe_yk_rebel = { set_variable = { name = var_oe_yk_pretender value = scope:oe_yk_dh } }
            scope:oe_yk_dh = { change_character_allegiance = scope:oe_yk_rebel }
            province_definition:uiju_province = {
                every_location_in_province_definition = {
                    limit = { owner ?= c:KOR }
                    every_pop = {
                        limit = { pop_type = pop_type:nobles }
                        add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_penalty
                        change_pop_allegiance = scope:oe_yk_rebel
                    }
                }
            }
            scope:oe_yk_rebel = { add_rebel_progress = 0.15 }
        }
        debug_log = "oe_yk probe: pretender rebel raised in Goryeo"
    }
    oe_yk_test_probe_log = yes
}
oe_yk_test_probe_log = { debug_log = "oe_yk probe: rebel=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_rebel')|0] progress%=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_rprog')|0] person=[GetCountry('CHI').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_yk_rd_dh')|0] (1000 alive, 1 Goryeo's list, 10 the Yuan's, 100 supports the rebel)" }
# Probe, second step: the rebel destroyed (destroy_rebel), then the readings (where did the person go?).
oe_yk_test_probe_end = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KOR c:KOR = { any_rebel = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } } }
        c:KOR = { random_rebel = { limit = { rebel_name_key = oe_yk_deokheung_rebels } save_scope_as = oe_yk_rebel_x } }
        destroy_rebel = scope:oe_yk_rebel_x
        debug_log = "oe_yk probe: the rebel destroyed"
    }
    oe_yk_test_probe_log = yes
}
